t: Beating cancer‐related fatigue with the Untire mobile app: Results from a waiting‐list randomized controlled trial - PMC
s: Persons with cancer‐related fatigue (CRF) were recruited across four English speaking countries, via social media, and randomized into intervention (n = 519) and control (n = 280) groups.
